Overview
This classic Feadship was launched in 1987 and has been maintained and upgraded to the highest of yachting standards.
An extensive interior refit was performed in the fall of 2007 with the styling by the New York interior designer Joanne de
Guardiola. The classic teak interiors are the backdrop for the blues and whites that she has mixed with woven leathers,
textiles and modern art.
The sky lounge and full beam main salon have new ceilings and state-of-the-art lighting systems as well as contemporary
furnishings to complement the teak panels. Large plasma televisions and new stereo systems have been added in both
salons. The sky lounge has a bar and the very spacious, full beam main salon has a gaming table and desk.
The owner's suite, forward on the main deck, has been reconfigured and a separate bath has been added, providing true
his and hers baths. The beautiful marble walls and Sherle Wagner fixtures ensure a luxurious environment which includes
a Jacuzzi bath and a shower. The master suite has a large screen plasma TV and new entertainment system.
There is a spacious full beam VIP suite, with a separate and private stairway, that has also been refurbished. The large
bathroom, finished in white Thasos marble, has been fully updated with Sherle Wagner fixtures.
There are four additional aft cabins, two queen and two twin, with ensuite baths, one with a tub and the remainder with
showers. The combination of cabins provide very comfortable accomodations for up to 12 guests.

 The main aft deck has a Jacuzzi with sun pads, two dining tables and sliding glass side screens that reduce cross winds,
but allow enough breeze to cool the area. The sun deck has been refit (fall 2009), moving the waverunners to the bow,
removing the crane/davit, adding railings and a 6 stool bar, along with a grill. Sunning beds have been added forward and
the exercise equipment is set up here, with an optional sun awning.
There is wireless intemet, VOIP telephone and full coverage Satellite Television that provide the most up-to-date
communication technologies.
